snippet.title: Lady Death: Demonicron Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
LADY DEATH: DEMONICRON is all new sword-slicing, magic-wielding, 15 level, multiplayer beat-em-up coming to Nintendo Switch, Playstation 5, and Steam! Tke game takes the best aspects of the 1990's 16-bit era arcade classics - little bit of Streets Of Rage, a pinch of Golden Axe and a dash of Mortal Kombat - all mixed together with a killer 90's industrial-metal soundtrack.

Follow us on our social media:
Kickstarter - https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/artofplaygames/lady-death-demonicron-new-retro-beat-em-up-video-game
Twitter - https://twitter.com/Lady_Death_Game
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/LadyDeathDemonicronInstagram - https://www.instagram.com/lady_death_game/
